_about: How enemies behave on the map. Each enemy's own speeds are in battle/enemies.json under 'field' (walk_speed, chase_speed, sight_m, give_up_s); 'default_field' is used when an enemy has none. sight_cone_deg is how wide an enemy sees in front of itself, close_notice_m is how near Red can be before it notices her from any side, lose_sight_mult is how much farther than sight_m Red must get to count as 'out of sight', give_up_s (per enemy) is how long it chases without sight before it gives up, rest_s is how long it stands out of breath after giving up, reaggro_cooldown_s is how long it ignores Red after that, linger_s is the pause at each patrol point, touch_radius/touch_height decide when it catches Red. first_turn: a hit counts as 'from behind' when the angle between a facing and the line to the other one is past back_dot (cosine); facing_dot is how much Red must face the enemy to ambush it. Everything is in world units and seconds.
